xrg_filesys_mode.reason: Original TU 83 (xrg_filesys_mode) merges io-ov12-00a487d0 (_PushMode/_PopMode, split from TU 82), io-ov12-00a489e0 (static _CurMode) and io-ov12-00a48a30 (XrgFileSysModeGet/XrgFileSysAlloc). (1) Review R1: _CurMode is the TU-local static defined here (0x00a489e0) before its only C users; both io-ov12-00a48a30's private.h and the shared include/xeno/io/functions.h (promoted from that private.h) declare `extern int _CurMode(void);`, which gives the identifier two linkages in one TU (cc1: `static declaration for _CurMode follows non-static`). The private.h line is dropped and the TU no longer includes xeno/io/functions.h (pulled in only by io-ov12-00a487d0's source); it includes xeno/io/types.h for RgHeap instead. (2) io-ov12-00a48a30's private.h declares InstanceOfRgHeapData/InstanceOfRgHeap as returning void *; the canonical shared declarations return RgHeap * (include/xeno/io/functions.h:23,27, core owns the name). They are written verbatim from the shared header and the private void * spellings are dropped (the value is only passed on to RgHeapAlloc(void *heap, ...)). Queued header fix (separate header-canon/header_harvest assignment): stop promoting the TU-local static _CurMode of OV12 xrg_filesys_mode into include/xeno/io/functions.h.
